verified_failure_mode.primary_failure: Acoustic CTC overconfidence and linear beam-search score mismatch
verified_failure_mode.description: Standard Wav2Vec2 CTC decodes with peaked frame logits (top-1 prob > 96.5%), which causes pyctcdecode's beam-pruning threshold (-10.0) to discard valid linguistic candidates. Furthermore, the standard linear scoring function (Logit + 0.30*LM - 1.00*Words) under-rewards multi-character Kashmiri morphemes.

quantitative_evidence.oracle_64_wer: 17.88% (a 9.32 pp oracle gap below Top-1 WER of 27.20%)
quantitative_evidence.better_candidate_in_beam_pct: 63.14% of calibration utterances possess a candidate with lower WER than Top-1

selected_intervention.name: Intervention E1+E2: Acoustic Temperature Calibration & Discriminative Length-Aware Rescoring
selected_intervention.type: Probabilistic decoding calibration and candidate rescoring

expected_measurable_outcome.generalization_target: Consistent WER reduction across disjoint validation partitions (dev_a_disjoint, dev_b_waaz, dev_c_clean) with zero regressions

experimental_cost.inference_latency_increase: < 1% (negligible linear vector dot-product on top-32 candidate strings)

stopping_condition: Halt if the calibrated decoder regresses on dev_b_waaz or dev_c_clean by more than +0.1 pp, or if held-out gain does not generalize.
